summary.name: auxi
summary.one_liner: auxi is an AI-powered PowerPoint add-in that takes slide drafts from LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT over MCP and builds brand-compliant decks inside PowerPoint.
use_cases: Turning an LLM-drafted storyline into formatted PowerPoint slides
Enforcing firm brand and chart standards across decks
Generating agendas and proposals from templates
Scanning a deck for formatting errors before sending to clients
Translating or editing existing PowerPoint decks
Building consulting or banking presentations with on-brand charts
summary.what_it_does:
auxi is a PowerPoint add-in that connects to LLMs such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Gemini over MCP. The LLM writes the content and structure, then hands the draft to auxi, which builds each slide on the user's templates, masters and assets. It enforces rules such as chart design, layouts, title placeholders, work zones and many brand book items like fonts, colours, and footnotes. The page also describes a checker that reviews the deck before output, plus features for generating agendas and proposals from templates.</what_it_does>
